data.narrative:
Picogrid is a Series A-stage Defense & Security company that has raised $45M+ to date. The valuation assessment draws on a comp universe of 10 private and 2 public peers operating in the same sector, including private-stage comparables Stark Defence ($4.0B), Castelion ($1.0B), Singularity ($400M), and NODA AI ($125M), alongside public benchmarks DRSHF and IDEAFORGE.NS.

Two triangulation methods were applied. The stage-progression approach uses the $45M total capital raised as a proxy baseline, applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for Series A to next-stage progression, yielding $90M. The peer-median method examines the four same-sector, same-stage private comparables, which span a range of $125M to $4.0B with a median valuation of $700M. The dispersion reflects meaningful heterogeneity in the cohort; the median proves more robust than the mean given the wide spread.

These methods triangulate to a valuation range of $76M (low) to $805M (high), with a median point of $395M. The median estimate reflects approximately a 4.4x step-up from total raised and sits below the peer median, suggesting either a discount to comparable stage peers or a smaller scale relative to the sample set. Key uncertainties include product differentiation within Defense & Security, customer traction metrics, and runway-to-next-milestone relative to the peer cohort. The wide range ($76M–$805M) reflects the heterogeneity of Defense & Security valuations at Series A rather than analytical imprecision.
